answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 46997 Country: India Title: about purity Question: I want to know that what should we do if there is a urine drop (peshab ka qatra) comes out in clothes after wudhu or during salah. Answer ID: 46997 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1202/812/L=10/1434) Wudhu shall break if urine drop comes during wudhu or salah. Such person should wash the place where the urine is smeared and then make wudhu again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
